question: List each customer's name with the number of orders they placed, most orders first.
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, count(o.id) AS order_count FROM joins_shop.customer c LEFT JOIN joins_shop.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: What is the mean tempo of all songs?
Which songs are faster than the mean tempo?
expected_sql: SELECT title FROM music_hall.song WHERE tempo > (SELECT avg(tempo) FROM music_hall.song)
